_instructions._format: Instruction entries are documentation only. Keep every required field, including for disabled modes; optional values must use null, not omitted keys. Paths are relative to the working directory. Percentages use fractions, e.g. 0.5 means 50%.
_instructions.input: Required: path to the reference genome FASTA file; plain FASTA and gzip-compressed .gz files are supported.
_instructions.outdir: Required: directory for simulation output files.
_instructions.batch: Required: positive integer number of replicates.
_instructions.batch_start: Optional positive integer or quoted decimal index, default "001". First replicate index; batch is the number to generate. For example, batch_start "007" and batch 3 produce 007-009. Indices use at least three digits, and seeds align with those indices. With --config, set this field instead of --batch-start.
_instructions.seed: Required: integer random seed for reproducible runs.
_instructions.chromosome_weight: Optional chromosome-to-selector-to-weight object, default {} (all multipliers 1). Example: {"chr1": {"SV": 2, "deletion": 3, "IS": 2, "IS1": 4}}. Specific IS type overrides IS event class, which overrides mode. Only whole-genome sampling is weighted; reference IS removal, reference-adjacent placement, and preferred BED searches take priority.
_instructions.dryrun: Optional boolean, default false: true writes truth TSV files, gzip sequence tables (*.sequences.txt.gz), and logs, skipping mutated-genome construction and FASTA files. With --config, set this field instead of using --dryrun. Resume with --simulate PATH_TO_DRYRUN_LOG; keep the reference, truth files, and sequence tables unchanged.
_instructions.debug: Optional boolean, default false: true writes SAMPLE.debug.tsv with truth-format rows in event injection order after the output FASTA succeeds. This setting is ignored when dryrun is true. The --debug flag can also enable it for a non-dry-run config invocation.
_instructions.fasta_compression_threshold: Optional nonnegative integer, default 100000000: gzip output FASTA (*.fasta.gz) when total reference length across all records is at least this many bases; otherwise write *.fasta. Set 0 to always gzip FASTA. Sequence tables are always gzip-compressed in both dry and normal runs. With --config, set this field instead of --fasta-compression-threshold.
_instructions.modes: Required: mode settings; keep all fields.
_instructions.snp: Required: SNP settings, even when disabled.
_instructions.sv: Required: structural variant settings, even when disabled.
_instructions.reference_is: Required: reference IS settings; optional BED input may be null.
_instructions.preferred_bed_targeting: Required: preferred placement settings; optional BED input may be null.
_instructions.is_elements: Required: list of complete IS objects; use [] for no IS elements.

_instructions.complex_mode: Required: true enables bundled components; false uses individually enabled modes.
_instructions.is_enabled: Required: true enables IS event simulation; false disables it. Complex mode forces true.
_instructions.snp_enabled: Required: true enables SNP event simulation; false disables it. Complex mode forces true.
_instructions.sv_enabled: Required: true enables SV event simulation; false disables it. Complex mode forces true.

_instructions.frequency: Required: scalar rate below 1, count at least 1, or integer count range such as 0-1; 0 disables genome-wide SNPs.
_instructions.transition: Required: nonnegative transition weight; the sum of both SNP weights must be positive.
_instructions.transversion: Required: nonnegative transversion weight; the sum of both SNP weights must be positive.
_instructions.boundary_snp_frequency: Required: scalar rate/count or a quoted integer count range such as "0-5"; 0 disables boundary SNPs. Unquoted ranges are not valid JSON.
_instructions.boundary_snp_window: Required: nonnegative window size in bp around SV/IS boundaries.

_instructions.specs: Required: list of complete SV specifications; [] requests no SV events.
_instructions.long_insertion_min_size: Required: insertion size threshold in bp for candidate/model sequence sourcing.
_instructions.long_insertion_candidates_fasta: Required key, optional value: FASTA path containing A/C/G/T candidate sequences, or null to use reference-based generation.
_instructions.long_insertion_local_window: Required: local reference window radius in bp for sequence generation.
_instructions.long_insertion_k: Required: positive integer k-mer size for sequence generation.

spec_fields.subtype: Required: deletion, insertion, inversion, duplication, or translocation.
spec_fields.size_range: Required: positive integer MIN-MAX size range in bp.
spec_fields.frequency: Required: scalar rate below 1, event count at least 1, or a quoted nonnegative integer count range such as "0-5"; 0 disables this specification. A range is sampled independently for each replicate.
spec_fields.cross_chromosome_count: Optional nonnegative integer: requested cross-chromosome events within the total frequency count; remaining events are same-chromosome. Capped at total events. Single-chromosome inputs use same-chromosome events only. Omit to preserve unrestricted legacy placement.

_instructions.known_is_bed: Required key, optional value: reference IS BED path or null to skip reference IS mode; coordinates are 0-based half-open, column 4 is the raw IS type.
_instructions.reference_removal_frequency_range: Required: per-IS-type scalar rate/count or integer count range; 0 preserves all reference copies.

_instructions.preferred_is_bed: Required key, optional value: preferred placement BED path or null to disable targeting; coordinates are 0-based half-open.
_instructions.preferred_bed_target_proportion: Required: target fraction from 0 to 1 of preferred intervals.
_instructions.preferred_bed_window: Required: nonnegative placement window in bp around preferred intervals.

_instructions.name: Required: unique nonempty IS name when is_seq is provided; FASTA headers are ignored. May be null only when is_seq is null.
_instructions.is_seq: Required key, optional value: FASTA file path or unprefixed A/C/G/T/N/- string; null skips this element. IS:sequence format is forbidden.
_instructions.simple_insertion_frequency_range: Required: full-length insertion integer count range, or scalar rate/count; 0 disables.
_instructions.partial_insertion_frequency_range: Required: partial insertion integer count range, or scalar rate/count; 0 disables.
_instructions.partial_insertion_proportion_range: Required: MIN-MAX fraction of IS length, with 0 < MIN <= MAX <= 1.
_instructions.nested_insertion_frequency_range: Required: nested two-copy event integer count range, or scalar rate/count; 0 disables.
_instructions.nested_mixed_percentage: Required: fraction from 0 to 1 using different IS types in nested events.
_instructions.reference_adjacent_insertion_percentage: Required: fraction from 0 to 1 of preserved matching reference copies receiving an adjacent insertion.
_instructions.reference_adjacent_mixed_percentage: Required: fraction from 0 to 1 using a different IS type for reference-adjacent insertions.
_instructions.consecutive_insertion_frequency_range: Required: zero-gap paired event integer count range, or scalar rate/count; 0 disables.
_instructions.consecutive_mixed_percentage: Required: fraction from 0 to 1 using different IS types in consecutive events.
_instructions.nearby_insertion_frequency_range: Required: nearby paired event integer count range, or scalar rate/count; 0 disables.
_instructions.nearby_insertion_gap_range: Required: positive integer MIN-MAX reference gap in bp.
_instructions.nearby_mixed_percentage: Required: fraction from 0 to 1 using different IS types in nearby events.
_instructions.flanking_deletion_size_ranges: Required: list of positive integer MIN-MAX sizes in bp for flanking deletion; pair each entry with one frequency entry.
_instructions.flanking_insertion_size_ranges: Required: list of positive integer MIN-MAX sizes in bp for flanking insertion; pair each entry with one frequency entry.
_instructions.flanking_inversion_size_ranges: Required: list of positive integer MIN-MAX sizes in bp for flanking inversion; pair each entry with one frequency entry.
_instructions.flanking_*_frequency_ranges: Required: list matching the size list length; ranges are inclusive integer event counts (0-1 means zero or one); scalar rates/counts also accepted.
